items.question: Is hair braiding suitable for all hair types?
items.answer: Most hair types, yes. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak we adjust the hair braiding technique to your hair's length, texture and condition. Before we start, we talk through your preferred style, braid size and whether you'd like extensions.

items.question: How long does hair braiding take?
items.answer: Hair braiding at Spa Bali Moon takes 30 minutes to 2 hours, depending on the style and your hair length. A simple style on short hair is quickest; longer, more detailed styles take more time.

items.question: Will hair braiding damage my hair?
items.answer: No, not when hair braiding is done correctly. Braiding is considered a protective hairstyle that helps reduce tangling in Bali's wind and humidity. At Spa Bali Moon we prepare and section your hair first, use a comfortable braiding technique and avoid excessive tension to keep your scalp comfortable. We also share simple aftercare tips.

items.question: How long do braids usually last?
items.answer: Many braid styles remain neat for several days or even longer. How long hair braiding from Spa Bali Moon lasts depends on the braid style, your daily activities and aftercare. Once your braids are finished, we share simple aftercare tips to help the style stay neat for longer in Bali's heat and humidity.

items.question: Can I bring a reference photo for my hair braiding?
items.answer: Yes. A reference photo helps Spa Bali Moon understand the style, braid pattern and overall look you'd like to achieve. Bring it to your hair braiding appointment or share it on WhatsApp when you book. Before braiding begins, we also discuss braid size, hair length and whether you'd like to include extensions.

items.question: Can I have braids with hair extensions?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, selected braid styles can be created with extensions for additional length or volume. We talk through extensions with you before braiding begins, together with your preferred style, braid size and hair length. For the extension price, message us on WhatsApp (+62 878-6317-5144), 9am to 11pm.

items.question: How much does hair braiding cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 279.000 for short hair, IDR 379.000 for medium hair and IDR 469.000 for long hair at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak. Short covers bob or shoulder-length hair. Extensions are available on selected styles; message us on WhatsApp for the price. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Where can I get my hair braided in Seminyak?
items.answer: At Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, or at your villa or hotel, where home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. We have been in business since 2009 and are open daily, 9am to 11pm. Book your hair braiding on WhatsApp, +62 878-6317-5144, and bring a reference photo if you have one.

items.question: Which braid styles do you offer?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon offers classic double Dutch, single Dutch, Dutch crown, cornrows, half-up Dutch braids, box braids, Dutch fishtail and braids with extensions. You can also bring a reference photo. Each style can be adapted to suit your hair, outfit and plans.

items.question: Can I have my hair braided at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with everything braiding needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book hair braiding for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my hair braiding?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your braids on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
